sameAnchorFloor.definition: ratio = meters[a][b] / haversine(anchors[a].anchor, anchors[b].anchor); the anchors are the exact walkway nodes routeBetweenNodes connects, so any ratio < 1 - tolerance is geometrically impossible and is a hard error (never clamped, skipped or hidden)

inputs.speeds: frontend/src/lib/campus/speeds.ts (verified equal to the inlined constants)

method.networkMeters: matrix meters — the runtime A* path length between the two anchor walkway nodes, recorded at matrix build time (stored at 1-decimal precision)
method.sameAnchorCrowMeters: inline haversine (R=6371000 m) between anchors[a].anchor and anchors[b].anchor — the exact endpoint coordinates of the routed path (anchor definition in the script header)
method.impliedMeters: matrix seconds x 1.4 m/s base speed (steps legs timed at 0.6 m/s inflate this)
method.reviewRound1BasisRemoved: round 1 divided by outline-centroid / registry-pin crow (not the routed endpoints), which admitted ratios < 1; that basis no longer exists in this script
